Copy marked hemingway is Hemingway's final draft (Nov 15, 2026). Copy marked placeholder is short stand-in text waiting for Hemingway. Nothing here is personal data. Submissions are stored in the private intake database and nothing is shown until a person approves it.

performersPage.title: Performers
performersPage.description: Celtic performers in Canada who are open to bookings: pipers, drummers, fiddlers, dancers, singers, bands and storytellers. Free to list.
intro: This is where you'll find Celtic performers in Canada who are open to bookings, from pipers and drummers to fiddlers, dancers, singers, bands and storytellers.
Every listing is free. There's no paid tier and no fees. If you perform and want to be listed, it takes a few minutes.
performersPage.empty: No performers listed yet. Be the first. It's free and only takes a few minutes.
performersPage.smallPrint: Listings are sent in by the performers themselves. Please contact them directly to book. The Celtic Coo isn't an agency and doesn't charge a fee or commission.

performerForm.heading: List yourself as a performer
performerForm.leadIn: Tell us about your act and we'll add you to the Performers page. It's free, and you can ask us to update or remove it any time.
performerForm.adultsNote: Listings are sent in by adults, 18 and older. Schools and bands with junior members are welcome. Please list them under the school or band name, and use your crest or logo as the photo. Leave out the names and photos of anyone under 18.
performerForm.nameHelp: The name you'd like people to see.
performerForm.baseHelp: City and province or territory, like Okotoks, Alberta.
performerForm.blurbHelp: 50 words or less. What you play, what kind of events you suit, anything that makes you stand out. We may trim it a little for length.
performerForm.emailHelp: We keep this private by default. We'll only use it to reach you about your listing, unless you tick the box below.
performerForm.showEmailLabel: Show this email on my listing so people can contact me to book.
performerForm.mediaHelp: One landscape photo, JPG or PNG. Schools and bands with junior members, please send your crest or logo instead.
performerForm.imageRights: Please only send a photo you took or have permission to use. If anyone else is clearly in it, make sure they're okay with it being online. No photos where anyone under 18 can be identified.
performerForm.adultConfirm: I'm 18 or older, and I'm allowed to share this information and photo.
performerForm.termsConfirm: I understand this listing is free and that The Celtic Coo may edit it for length or remove it.
performerForm.success: Thanks, we've got it. We'll look over your listing and aim to have it up on the Performers page within a few days. If we have a question, we'll email you. If you want something changed later, just reply to our email.

performerExtra.mediaLinkNote: Paste a link to a photo or video you own, like a page on your website or a public post. We can't take file uploads yet.
performerExtra.associationHelp: For example, a pipe band grade or a dance association.
performerExtra.aboutYouHelp: We never show this on the site.
performerExtra.roleLabel: How you're connected to this act
performerExtra.newsletterLabel: Yes, send me The Coo's Letter, the free email about Celtic events in Canada, every two weeks. I can unsubscribe at any time.
performerExtra.privacyNote: We keep your listing details in a private database until we review them. Only the public parts show on the site after we approve it. Your name, and your email unless you ask, stay private.

groupForm.lessonKindsHelp: For example, beginner chanter, Highland dance, Gaelic for adults.

groupForm.aboutYouHelp: We never show this on the site.

groupForm.termsConfirm: I understand this listing is free and that The Celtic Coo may edit it or remove it.

inquiryReply.note: Free-listing reply for when a performer emails us. A person sends it after review. Nothing sends on its own.
inquiryReply.subject: Thanks for reaching out
inquiryReply.body:
Hi there,

Thanks for getting in touch. We'd be happy to list you on The Celtic Coo's Performers page. It's free, with no fees or paid tiers.

The quickest way is our form at celticcoo.ca/submit. If you'd rather reply here, just send:

- your performer or group name
- what you do (pipes, fiddle, dance and so on)
- where you're based and how far you'll travel
- a short blurb, 50 words or less
- a booking email (we keep it private unless you'd like it shown on your listing)
- one website or social link, if you have one
- one landscape photo you own the rights to, if you have one (please, no photos where kids can be identified)

Listings come from adults, 18 and older. Schools and bands with junior members can list under the school or band name, with a crest or logo as the photo. We may trim your blurb a little for length, and we'll aim to have it up within a few days.

Cheers,
The Celtic Coo
